intent: A fen-mourning Victorian gown: a pale mist-grey bodice and pale sleeves pinched by a narrow willow sash over a full bell skirt that flares from the waist, with long willow strands, a black lace cap and short veil, and cold wisp-blue dew, so the high camera reads a pale A-line bride under a black-veiled head.
requests: A translucent or alpha-cut lace material, so the black lace reads as lace rather than solid cloth.
A tapered cone primitive for skirts, so the bell is one clean flare instead of stepped panels that can show a seam where the thigh and shin panels meet.
A collar that can stand at the neck and still be seen from the high camera: any collar inside the neck width is hidden by the blocky head above the torso.
